title: Price and package a product
summary: Pricing and packaging decide what customers pay for and what they get. They shape who buys, how they use the product and how the business grows.

intermediate: Choose a value metric that grows with customer value.
Design simple packages and test them.
experienced: Choose a value metric that scales with customer success.
Design packages for different segments, with clear reasons to upgrade.
Test prices with research and controlled experiments.
Plan price changes and how to treat existing customers.

canDelegateTo.task: Analyse usage and revenue by segment
Check pricing terms and consumer law

toolExamples.power-bi: Model revenue under different pricing scenarios.
toolExamples.google-docs: Document pricing principles and the reasoning behind each package.

definitionOfDone: Packages designed with clear upgrade reasons
pitfalls: Pricing from cost rather than value
Changing prices without a plan for existing customers

sources.title: SaaS pricing and packaging for modern B2B teams (Schematic)
